# MCCE

> MCCE is the M.S. in Computer and Communication Engineering, a two-year graduate program in the Department of Computer and Communications Engineering at Lebanese International University (LIU). This site is an independent, student-built materials browser for the program: it indexes course files from the program's shared drive so they can be searched and browsed by semester, course, and file type.

This site is not an official LIU page. For admissions, curriculum, and official program details, see the official program page linked below.

## Program facts

- Program: M.S. in Computer and Communication Engineering (MCCE)
- Department: Department of Computer and Communications Engineering (CCE)
- University: Lebanese International University (LIU)
- Duration: Two years, combining coursework with a research project
- Focus areas: telecommunications, data communications, network architecture, wireless systems, optical networking

## Pages

- [Program materials](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/): Browse indexed course materials by source and semester.
- [Search](https://mcce.khaledsaeed.tech/search): Search materials by name, semester, course, or file type.

## Official sources

- [MCCE graduate program page](https://cce.liu.edu.lb/academic-programs/graduate-programs): Official LIU program page for admissions and curriculum.
- [Department of Computer and Communications Engineering](https://cce.liu.edu.lb): Official LIU department page.
